title: A whole-epic submission with a non-write grade boots the container agent, which the witness tests do not cover
body: The acceptance's teeth (the RUN_WORKFLOW witness) holds the plain-write shape only: an epic run submitted with credential_grade "read_only" still routes to RUN_WORKFLOW by the grade rule in reconcilerDrives, and no test asserts that shape's driver. It is unreachable through today's submitters (only pr-review submits read_only, for a synthetic epic), but the routing of a read_only REAL-epic run is an untested edge.
